title: Micro mitts
text: Micro mitts. I first found these while on Maui... have been looking for them on the mainland ever since.  I was thrilled to see them here on Amazon.  You might think they are just another set of oven mitts.. but they are SOOO useful - mainly due to their size.  I use my toaster oven quite often.  Regular size oven mitts are harder to use with the smaller oven - so these are perfect.  If you use a microwave, you can pick up super hot glass items easily with these, again, because of their useful size.  They are very thick.. and easily fit over your fingers for use - protecting your hands..  One word of warning... do not use if they are wet as this will transfer the heat to your fingers.  They are not water/liquid proof.  This is the case with most oven mitts.  I ordered the set of 5 to get the best price.  They came in 5 different colors and received exactly what is pictured in the set of 5 ad.  They are machine washer/dryer safe.  I actually dry them flat in my dryer "closet."  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
